_about: Apify scrapers that have worked for each portal. Placeholders: {{keyword}} = one settings.search.keywords item (or the list for actors that take a list as {{keywords}}), {{location}} = the first settings.search.locations item, {{locations}} = the whole list, {{days}} = posted_within_days, {{max}} = limits.fetch_per_portal. Scraper names and inputs change over time: if one fails, find a replacement with search-actors and update this file in the candidate's store. Prices are billed to the candidate's own Apify account.

naukri.notes: staticCompanyName is a naukri.com company-page URL, not a name: derive the company from the URL slug. locations.label is often missing; fall back to the city names in the job's URL slug.

instahyre.notes: URL is 'publicUrl' and location is 'locationsRaw': alias them to url/location before filtering, or the location filter silently does nothing.

hirist.tech.notes: Pass 1 has no description field. For pass 2, re-run the same search with includeJobDescription:true and read only the kept job_ids' descriptions. Omit categorySlug entirely (an empty string fails validation).

foundit.notes: URL is 'apply_url': alias it to url before filtering. postedWithinDays is a string.

notes: Some actors need callOptions.maxTotalChargeUsd (not maxItems), or the call fails with a minimum-cost error. Job pages on these portals are usually not reachable with curl from the sandbox; Apify or the browser are the only ways to get the JD text.
